text_block_list.text:
While discussing the next experiment with 
Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Tachyon, nice timing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Taiki-kun. What brings you 
to a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... Right now I'm having a bit of 
lucky trouble!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So, pleeease! Help me ooout!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I am aware this is an establishment where 
one can swiftly consume a massive block of 
calories, but..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still... what's with this sheer amount?

Where Agnes Tachyon is looking, a massive 
pile of hamburgers is stacked high on the 
table...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I ordered them online, but the shop made a 
mistake and 20 turned into 200!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They gave it to me for free, but there's 
no way I can eat all this alone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Tachyon, please accept this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh... I appreciate the thought, but 
your nutritional balance is going to be 
terrible."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In terms of quick convenience, it may 
provide plenty of calories, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're lacking way too much essential 
nutrients like Vitamin C and dietary 
fiber.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, taking supplements would 
make the act of eating far simpler, and 
besides—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! I see, I understand completely now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“No need to worry, though! The hamburger 
is huge and delicious!”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Big is justice! Delicious is justice! 
Which means, everything is A-OKAY!!" || 
"Big is justice! Delicious is justice! 
Which means it's all completely fine!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you really don't get it at all, do 
you?

It is true that I haven't had lunch yet, 
and I do appreciate the quick turnaround, 
but...
choice_data_list:
Since we went to all this trouble, why not 
have some?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I think that's for the best.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Taiki. I appreciate the 
thought, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Too bad! Can't be helped, though!

I helped carry the massive order of 
burgers and headed back to the Academy.

Rumor has it that the remaining half 
brought back was eagerly tossed into the 
mouth of a gray-haired Umamusume whose 
eyes sparkled with delight...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... Well, trying something I wouldn't 
normally eat could be an interesting 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'll gladly take you up on that, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thank you! Please eat it before it 
spoils!

Saying so, Taiki Shuttle left behind about 
twenty hamburgers. I ended up having to 
eat most of them myself, but—

Having eaten an uncharacteristic mountain 
of hamburgers, Agnes Tachyon was left 
completely unable to move for a while...
